comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
About a year from now, whenever chapter 1 from the "Age of Revolution" update is released, it looks like this skill will finally allow players to make Chinese/Japanese translation notes.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Update/IndustrialRevolution -- namely, listed under Factory production (printing press) according to Google Translate

Chinese/Thai-Burmese notes: R5
C/T-B Dictionary: R8
Korean/Japanese notes: R7
K/J Dictionary: R10

There will be other requirements I don't fully understand yet, mainly to do with that whole industrial revolution angle... but hey. Now we know.
